purpose: Respond to listening feedback that Batch 006 is acceptable but not bottom-level enough by creating original procedural foundation stems and finished previews.
hardGates: No third-party music source in Batch 007 foundation stems.
No audible human voice, speech, humming, chanting, crowd, or vocal texture.
Sleep must be dark, slow, and non-celebratory.
Focus must not be perceived as white noise, traffic, fan, or harsh masking.
Every candidate must expose explicit stem roles so Recipe V2 can later select and refine structure.

stems.title: Sleep Sub Body A
stems.notes: Dark, slow, non-celebratory body. Intended to be felt more than followed.

stems.title: Sleep Warm Night Air A
stems.notes: Barely moving air layer; not white noise and not a room recording.

stems.title: Calm Breathing Harmonic A
stems.notes: Audible slow inhale/exhale movement created by harmony, not hiss.

stems.title: Calm Open Room Color A
stems.notes: Wide, warm spatial color for calm mixes; avoids foreground melody.

stems.title: Focus Clean Pulse A
stems.notes: Very restrained tonal work pulse. No noise mask, traffic, fan, or beat.

stems.title: Focus Low Anchor A
stems.notes: Stable low anchor so focus does not become white/pink/brown noise.

candidates.title: Sub-Blanket Descent
candidates.question: Does this feel bottom-level and sleep-safe without sounding festive, pretty, or like a song?
candidates.structure: low body is present immediately -> warm night air slowly grows -> upper detail fades -> stable dark blanket remains
rejectedPatterns: third-party music as the main identity
cheerful, festive, bright, cute, romantic, or narrative sleep music
white/pink/brown noise wall used as focus identity
audible human voice, humming, chanting, crowd, or speech

candidates.title: Return-to-Sleep Floor
candidates.question: Can this sit under a half-awake state without creating emotional brightness or narrative attention?
candidates.structure: lower, flatter variant; less air and more body than the bedtime version
rejectedPatterns: third-party music as the main identity
cheerful, festive, bright, cute, romantic, or narrative sleep music
white/pink/brown noise wall used as focus identity
audible human voice, humming, chanting, crowd, or speech

candidates.title: Breathing Room Foundation
candidates.question: Does this feel intentional and breathable while still staying below foreground music?
candidates.structure: warm breath cycle leads -> open room color widens -> no bell/event payoff
rejectedPatterns: third-party music as the main identity
cheerful, festive, bright, cute, romantic, or narrative sleep music
white/pink/brown noise wall used as focus identity
audible human voice, humming, chanting, crowd, or speech

candidates.title: Clean Underwork Engine
candidates.question: Can this support work without becoming a noise wall or a track that asks to be listened to?
candidates.structure: clean tonal pulse -> low anchor underneath -> minimal spectral movement only
rejectedPatterns: third-party music as the main identity
cheerful, festive, bright, cute, romantic, or narrative sleep music
